title: Guidepoint Launches MCP Server on Anthropic's Claude for Research Workflows
summary: Guidepoint launched a Model Context Protocol (MCP) server integrated with Anthropic's Claude, letting research teams pull from Guidepoint's library of 100,000+ expert interview transcripts directly inside AI-enabled research workflows. The release is part of Guidepoint's broader push to embed expert content into the AI tools clients already use.
whyItMatters: MCP servers are quickly becoming the standard integration layer for expert networks — Third Bridge, Guidepoint, and others are shipping them within months of each other, making AI-tool interoperability a near-term competitive baseline.
